newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot market slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot market slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle on Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 6,100 slaughter steers and 4,400 heifers; 13,400 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 66.00.
Confirmed - 10,500 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 300
Wk to Date - 13,400 Week Ago - 4,400 Year Ago - 300
